message.content: {"caption":"A comparison of fixed memory instructions with principle-guided memory optimization for AI agents.","description":"The infographic shows a person teaching an AI agent principles for managing memory: understanding goals, evaluating what to remember, and organizing, updating, or discarding information. Guided by these principles, the agent selects important information, compresses and structures it, updates it, and forgets what is unimportant. The lower panels contrast forcing a model to follow a predefined strategy or format, producing rigid memory, with teaching the model optimization skills to produce more flexible, adaptive memory.","figure_type":"diagram","chart_values":[]}
